shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright monolithic pillar/stela face
repeated framed rectangular compartments containing motifs
elements organised into registers/bands across the surface
justification: Both surfaces carry low relief on the flat face of an upright pillar and both include a series of repeated framed compartments filled with small motifs (A's row of three arched panels with rows of signs; B's stacked glyph-like blocks), and both may contain small profile heads. But A is fundamentally a figural scene of large animals in profile (canid, bird, snake-like forms) with a zigzag band and a small human-like figure, arranged in horizontal registers, whereas B is an all-over field of dense, uniformly sized sign-blocks in vertical columns with no large figural subject and no comparable relationships between creatures.
